name: Player can successfully join a created game
why: When a game exists in waiting_setup, a valid player should be able to join and receive a 200 response

name: Duplicate join attempt is rejected
why: A player already in the game should not be able to join again, and the server should return 400

name: Player 2 cannot fire before Player 1
why: The game starts with player 1's turn, so player 2 firing first should return 403 forbidden

name: Player 1 fires valid shot and gets result
why: A valid move during gameplay should return 200 and include the next player turn

name: Game stats endpoint returns valid data during game
why: Fetching stats during an active game should return 200 and include game-related fields
